title: Lidar Sensor
text: Generate lidar point cloud data for a scene, 1 input, 4 outputs, {Sensor model to choose typical values} sets Name of sensor model; {Unique identifier of sensor} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Required interval between sensor updates (s)} sets the required time interval between sensor, {Position [X Y Height] (m)} sets the sensor center position, {Orientation [Roll Pitch Yaw] (deg)} sets the sensor orientation, {MATLAB or Model workspace Actor profiles variable name} sets the variable name for actor profiles, {ActorID of the host vehicle} sets the actor ID of ego vehicle, {Coordinate system to report point cloud data} sets the coordinate system of reported detections, {Maximum detection range of sensor (m)}, {Azimuth limits (deg)} sets the azimuth limits of lidar sensor, {Azimuth resolution (deg)} sets the azimuthal resolution of lidar sensor, {Use elevation angles} uses custom elevation angles, {Elevation angles (deg)} sets the elevation angles of lidar sensor N -element real-valued, {Elevation limits (deg)} sets the elevation limits of lidar sensor, {Elevation resolution (deg)} sets the elevation resolution of lidar sensor, {Add noise to measurements}, {Range accuracy (m)} sets the accuracy of sensor range measurement, {Fog visibility in meters} sets the visible distance in fog, {Rainrate in mm/hour} sets the rate of rainfall, {Simulate Motion Distortion}, {Laser firing time (s)} sets the firing times of lasers in lidar sensor, {Material attribute information in JSON format}, {Edit JSON text to add, remove, or modify material attributes}, {Output intensity port} sets the output intensity values of points and {Output clusters port} sets the output segmentation values of points. Values come from the instance.
